hero-desc: KIJ is a multi-agent AI platform that analyzes, guides, and supports — whether you are an organization, a professional, or someone in need.
modules-desc: The same AI architecture, two concrete applications — and the AND logic: always both.
module-platform-desc: Document analysis, report generation, linguistic correction, monitoring, patents, and professional deliverables — orchestrated by 20 specialized agents.
feature-analysis-desc: CVs, contracts, reports, invoices, images, tables
module-human-desc: Supporting vulnerable people: employment, housing, health, rights, training, and psychosocial support — without judgment, with dignity.
feature-docs-desc: Written and personalized to the situation
how-desc: From file drop or request to final report — automatically.
step1-desc: The user sends a file, a question, or fills out a form. n8n receives and routes automatically.
step2-desc: Claude corrects the request, Gemini reads heavy files, Perplexity verifies recent info.
step3-desc: The orchestrator activates the right agents (legal, linguistic, employment, quality…) based on detected content.
step4-desc: Supabase stores everything. The final report is delivered by email, PDF, or dashboard — with confidence level.
tech-desc: Eight complementary tools, one AND logic: all activated as needed.
cta-desc: Start with the free stack. Add paid tools when limits are reached.
footer-desc: Multi-agent AI platform for intelligent analysis, humanitarian aid, and professional integration.
footer-powered: AI assistant powered by Claude (Anthropic) · Ethics & GDPR
